g.title: PMDD_QSP
g.text: Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder — Integrated QSP Mechanistic Map

HPO-axis cycle engine · progesterone→5α-DHP→allopregnanolone neurosteroidogenesis · GABA-A α4βδ subunit plasticity (slow) · NON-MONOTONIC (inverted-U) neurosteroid transduction · corticolimbic gain · DRSP symptom domains

SSRI (luteal / continuous / symptom-onset) · drospirenone-EE 24/4 vs 21/7 · GnRH agonist ± E2/P4 add-back · sepranolone (isoallopregnanolone) · dutasteride 0.5 vs 2.5 mg · ulipristal · alprazolam · calcium · oophorectomy
